- Initial release of phy-post-forensics: a structural analyzer for social media post performance.
- Extracts 12 research-backed linguistic and structural features from your posts.
- Groups and compares posts by engagement tier to identify patterns unique to your own top-performing content.
- Generates actionable, data-backed insights and a content blueprint to improve future posts.
- Designed for pure content analysis—separates content quality from distribution luck, with zero external dependencies.
